import copy,json,subprocess
CMD=['python3','/workspace/submission/main.py']
def run(d):
 p=subprocess.run(CMD,input=json.dumps(d,separators=(',',':')).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 assert p.returncode==0 and not p.stderr,(p.returncode,p.stderr)
 x=json.loads(p.stdout);assert 'error' not in x,x;return x

def base(W=1):
 C=2;E=1
 return {'version':1,'config':{'slots':1,'window':W,'idle_timeout':100,'len_quantum':1,'gap_quantum':1,'rate_num':100,'rate_den':1,'bucket_capacity':100,'initial_tokens':100,'pending_capacity':10,'lanes':2,'service':[10,1],'fallback':0,'time_edges':[0],'count_edges':[0],'probability':[[65536]]},'model':{'classes':2,'embedding_dim':1,'length_embedding':[[i] for i in range(16)],'gap_embedding':[[0] for _ in range(16)],'kernel':1,'conv_weights':[[[1,0]]],'conv_bias':[0],'conv_shift':[0],'dense_weights':[[0],[1]],'dense_bias':[0,0]},'connections':[{'id':'a','slot':0,'label':0,'split':'dev'}],'packets':[]}
# Later short job completes and applies before older long job, making job 0 superseded.
d=base();d['packets']=[{'time':0,'connection':'a','length':0,'draw':0},{'time':1,'connection':'a','length':1,'draw':0},{'time':2,'connection':'a','length':1,'draw':0}]
x=run(d)
assert [j['done'] for j in x['jobs']]==[10,2,3],x['jobs']
assert [j['status'] for j in x['jobs']]==['superseded','applied','applied'],x['jobs']
assert x['packets'][2]['forward']==1,x['packets']
# A completion at the exact timeout is handled first; lookup then resets the episode.
d=base();d['config']['idle_timeout']=10
d['packets']=[{'time':0,'connection':'a','length':1,'draw':0},{'time':1,'connection':'a','length':1,'draw':0}]
x=run(d);assert x['jobs'][0]['done']==1 and x['jobs'][0]['status']=='applied'
assert x['packets'][1]['forward']==1 # job 0 completed at t=1, before forwarding
# t=9 does not expire; t=10 does. The old job's completion at t=1 remains applied.
d=base();d['config']['idle_timeout']=10
d['packets']=[{'time':0,'connection':'a','length':1,'draw':0},{'time':9,'connection':'a','length':0,'draw':0},{'time':10,'connection':'a','length':0,'draw':0}]
x=run(d)
assert [p['generation'] for p in x['packets']]==[1,1,2],x['packets']
assert x['packets'][1]['forward']==1 and x['packets'][2]['forward']==0,x['packets']
assert x['jobs'][0]['status']=='applied' and all(j['status']=='stale' for j in x['jobs'][1:]),x['jobs']
# Positive halfway rounding is away from zero, with ReLU and saturation after rounding.
for z,shift,expected in [(1,1,1),(3,1,2),(-1,1,0),(255,1,127),(127,0,127),(128,0,127),(-5,0,0)]:
 d=base();d['model']['conv_bias']=[z];d['model']['conv_shift']=[shift]
 d['packets']=[{'time':0,'connection':'a','length':0,'draw':0}]
 x=run(d);assert x['jobs'][0]['logits']==[0,expected],(z,shift,x['jobs'][0])
# Equal vote counts select the smallest class.
d=base();d['config']['service']=[1,1]
d['packets']=[{'time':0,'connection':'a','length':0,'draw':0},{'time':1,'connection':'a','length':1,'draw':0},{'time':2,'connection':'a','length':1,'draw':0}]
x=run(d)
assert x['connections'][0]['votes']==[2,1] # fallback, fallback, then class 1 feedback
# Explicit vote tie using cached class 1 and two fallback-first packets is checked by aggregation formula separately.
print('targeted replay and CNN tests passed')
